Method of Attack: Information disclosure via unsafe usage of shared memory in Cisco Webex Meetings Desktop App for Windows, exposing auth tokens, usernames, and meeting information to local authenticated attackers
Exploitation of improperly secured trace files containing email accounts, meeting URLs, and WebExAccessToken allowing impersonation and unauthorized access
Discoverer: Trustwave SpiderLabs Security Research Manager Martin Rakhmanov
Impacted Systems: Cisco Webex Meetings Desktop App for Windows releases earlier than 40.6.0
Windows systems with Cisco Webex Meetings Windows app configured to log in automatically
Attack Vector: Local authenticated attacker exploiting shared memory vulnerability in the Cisco Webex Meetings Desktop App for Windows
